config.name: Platform Value Overview — Read First
config.description: Read first guide for this dashboard.
config.content:
Platform Value Overview
Executive landing page for health, coverage, and platform value.
Questions this dashboard answers
  • Are we healthy right now (alert posture)?
  • Are collectors alive?
  • What is our monitoring footprint and license mix?
  • Where should we drill next?
Recommended review flow
  1. Scan severity KPIs — Critical / Error / Warning
  2. Check collectors — Alive vs down
  3. Review map and NOC — Concentration of risk
  4. Drill only when signaled — Alerts, Coverage, Collectors
Where to go next
  • Elevated alerts → 03 Active Alerts
  • Dead/minimal → 02 Resource Health / 11 Exec
  • License pressure → 13 / 04
  • Down collectors → 07 Collector Diagnostics
Tip: Empty or zero values may mean healthy state or missing tokens/LogicModules — confirm before concluding.
